title: Review of lab 1's ad4-protocell (IB) on fresh seeds 5 and 6: planted catalyst droplets persist as bounded individuals for the whole run (tracks over t=500-20000 at constant size), each wrapped in a psi shell (rim/core 3.6, 56/57 individuals)
summary: labkit re-runs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad4-protocell/world.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (frames 200, t=20000, 128^2), with the pack's settings. Seed 5: 9-11 droplets, 6 splits, 5 persistent, max generation 2, 1 merge. Seed 6: 10-12 droplets, 7 splits, 6 persistent, generation 2, 1 merge. In rerun/seed5/tracks.png the top tracks (#2, #7, #8, #13) persist at nearly constant size from t~500 to 20000, each kind of catalyst (cyan and lilac cores) inside a bright shell. psi (amphiphile) is membrane-like (rim/core 3.58 and rim/outside 18.1 on seed 5, 56/57 individuals). Seed 6 gives the same picture.

observations.I: rerun/seed5/tracks.png: tracks #2, #7, #8 and #13 persist at bounded, nearly constant size for t~500-20000; 9-12 droplets on both seeds

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders. I saw the psi shell (rim/core 3.6) but did not check whether it is a dynamically independent layer or a readout of the droplet field (lab 1 calls it inert), so B is not checked. Division stays at generation 2, as lab 1 noted.
